samples.question: Four dark convex polygons are drawn, one in each quadrant of the image (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), and they are all the same size. The number of sides of a polygon is how many straight edges bound it. Exactly three of the polygons have the same number of sides, while the fourth polygon has a different number of sides. Which quadrant contains the polygon whose number of sides is different from the other three?
